description: Timestamp 25 hours before receive time. Upstream has no range check.

expected_holocron.notes: Confirmed (Mike, 2026-10-03): no payload is refused for its event time, matching upstream (docs/decisions/0002, Event time; docs/decisions/0005, Event time outcomes). Respond only after the payload is durably committed (briefing, durability). Keep the {cache, sessionId, visitId} shape (briefing, identity). Values come from the identity derivation in docs/decisions/0001, so they will not equal upstream values. Inside retention, so stored. Its day key normally still exists (destroyed at end(D) + 25h); if it is gone the event is stored keyless (docs/decisions/0001, Key retention and keyless events).
